course.title: Unit 3 Where did you go?-Part C--【例句】

sentences.content: Today was a sunny day. In the morning, we had a lot of fun.
sentences.english: Today was a sunny day . In the morning , we had a lot of fun
sentences.chinese: 今天是个阳光明媚的日子。早晨，我们玩得非常开心。

sentences.content: Dad and I dressed up and made a funny play. Robin played the part of a dog.
sentences.english: Dad and I dressed up and made a funny play . Robin played the part of a dog
sentences.chinese: 我和爸爸盛装打扮，演了一出滑稽戏。Robin扮演了一只狗。

sentences.content: Max liked Robin so much. He jumped on him and licked him.
sentences.english: Max liked Robin so much . He jumped on him and licked him
sentences.chinese: Max非常喜欢Robin。他扑到Robin身上舔他。

sentences.content: It was a bad day but also a good day!
sentences.english: It was a bad day but also a good day !
sentences.chinese: 这是糟糕的一天，但也是美好的一天！

sentences.content: Am I on the moon? I can’t believe it!
sentences.english: Am I on the moon ? I can't believe it !
sentences.chinese: 我这是到月球了吗？简直难以置信！

sentences.content: I saw Chang’e, the rabbit and the tree. Did you take any pictures?
sentences.english: I saw Chang'e , the rabbit and the tree . Did you take any pictures ?
sentences.chinese: 我看见了嫦娥、玉兔和月桂树。你拍照了吗？
